---
title: "PCA from First Principles"
---

This project develops an understanding of principal component analysis
through mathematical explanations, worked examples, and reproducible
Python code.

## Approach

Each lecture will connect a concrete question to the mathematical
objects, operations, and assumptions needed to answer it. Accompanying
Python examples will make the reasoning executable and inspectable.

## Lectures

1. [What Does It Mean to Represent Something Mathematically?](lectures/01-mathematical-representation/index.qmd) — Objects, measurements, labels, and the meaning of numerical relationships.

2. [From a Scalar to a List of Measurements](lectures/02-scalars-and-measurements/index.qmd) — Scalar values, ordered observations, mixed units, and semantic Python types.

## Project status

The first two conceptual lectures include executable Python companions. Automated checks validate Python formatting, package imports, and website rendering, including the companion output. PCA algorithms and their mathematical tests will follow as the lectures develop.

## Source code

The source files and development history are available in the
[GitHub repository](https://github.com/hafizarslanamjad/pca-from-first-principles).
